aggregate_data <- function(data, 
                           cols_to_keep, 
                           pop_col,
                           agg_noneuca = TRUE){
  
  pop_cols <- c("pop_ACS", "pop_MPI")
  
  data_pop <- data %>% 
    select(-setdiff(pop_cols, pop_col)) %>%
    rename("pop" = !!sym(pop_col))
  
  raw_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
  # find geographic keys
  geo_keys <- intersect(cols_to_keep, c("state", "region"))
  
  # aggregate regions if requested
  if(agg_noneuca){
    data_pop <- data_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "nonEUCA")) %>%
      group_by(pick(-c(n_arrests, pop))) %>%
      summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests),
                pop = sum(pop))
    
    raw_pop <- raw_pop %>% 
      mutate(region = ifelse(region == "EUCA", "EUCA", "nonEUCA")) %>%
      group_by(state, region) %>%
      summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  }
  # population map
  pop_map <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")
  
   # checksum value
  checksum <- data_pop %>%
    group_by(state, region, pop) %>%
    slice_head(n=1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(region) %>%
    summarize(pop_checksum = sum(pop), .groups = "drop")

  # aggregate arrests, join population back in
  data_pop <- data_pop %>%
    group_by_at(cols_to_keep) %>%
    summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pop_map, by = geo_keys) %>%
    mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000,
           log_pop = log(pop))
  
  # checksum
  total_aggregated <- data_pop %>%
    group_by_at(geo_keys) %>%
    summarize(pop = first(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(pop) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  total_checksum <- sum(checksum$pop_checksum, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!(dplyr::near(total_checksum, total_aggregated))) {
    warning("Checksum Failed!")
  }
  
  return(data_pop)
}

jackknife_supt <- function(fe_fit, model_fml, data, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), extra_fml = NULL, do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = F, m_vals = c()) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  coef0      <- coef(fe_fit)
  states     <- unique(data$state)
  n_states   <- length(states)

  windows <- setdiff(min(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))):max(as.numeric(as.character(data$window))), -1)

  if (do_se) {
    jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
      sub_data <- subset(data, state != dropped_state)

      if (model_type == "poisson") {
        coef(fepois(model_fml, data = sub_data, offset = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      } else {
        coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state))
      }
    }))

    # calculate variance-covariance matrix
    jackknife_est_means <- colMeans(jackknife_est_matrix)
    vcov_unscaled       <- jackknife_est_matrix |>
      scale(center = jackknife_est_means, scale = FALSE) |>
      crossprod()
    scaling_factor <- (n_states - 1) / n_states
    vcov           <- scaling_factor * vcov_unscaled
    se             <- sqrt(diag(vcov))

    # Gaussian sup-t critical value
    # (Montiel Olea & Plagborg-Møller 2019)
    sims           <- rmvnorm(10000, sigma = cov2cor(vcov))
    critical_value <- quantile(apply(abs(sims), 1, max), 0.95)

    if (model_type == "poisson") {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = exp(coef0), se = se,
                     lower  = exp(coef0 - critical_value * se),
                     upper  = exp(coef0 + critical_value * se))
    } else {
      supt <- tibble(window = windows,
                     est    = coef0, 
                     se = se,
                     lower  = coef0 - critical_value * se,
                     upper  = coef0 + critical_value * se)
    }
  } else {
    est_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") exp(coef0) else coef0
    supt    <- tibble(window = windows, est = est_val, se = 0, lower = est_val, upper = est_val)
  }

  ref_val <- if (model_type == "poisson") 1 else 0
  output <- supt |>
    bind_rows(tibble(window = -1, est = ref_val, se = 0, lower = ref_val, upper = ref_val)) |>
    arrange(window)
  
   if(do_sensitivity){
    honest_data <- output |> filter(window != -1) |> arrange(window)
    honest_betahat <- honest_data$est
    honest_sigma <- vcov
    
    numPrePeriods <- 6
    numPostPeriods <- 7
    pre_period_indices <- 1:numPrePeriods
    l_vec <- rep(1 / numPostPeriods, numPostPeriods)
    
    # wald
    pre_coef_names <- names(coef0)[1:numPrePeriods]
    wald_test <- fixest::wald(fe_fit, keep = pre_coef_names, vcov = vcov)
    print("Wald Pre-Trend Test")
    print(wald_test)

    delta_rm_results <- HonestDiD::createSensitivityResults_relativeMagnitudes(
                                    betahat = honest_betahat,
                                    sigma = honest_sigma,
                                    numPrePeriods = numPrePeriods,
                                    numPostPeriods = numPostPeriods,
                                    l_vec = l_vec,
                                    method = "C-LF",
                                    Mbarvec = m_vals
                                    )

    print("M bar Results")
    print(delta_rm_results)
    
  } 
  return(output)
  
}

event_study_plot <- function(estimates, pal, baseline = 0, show_guide = TRUE) {
  if (!"conv_status" %in% colnames(estimates)) {
    estimates <- estimates |> 
      dplyr::mutate(conv_status = dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(conv_method, "_conv"), "conv", "nonconv"))
  }
  
  estimates |>
    ggplot(aes(x = window, y = est, color = conv_method, group = conv_method)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.3)) + 
    labs(x = "Window",
         y = "Difference in Arrests per 1k\nrelative to EUCA and window -1") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(estimates$window), max(estimates$window), by = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pal, guide = if (show_guide) "legend" else "none") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}


fit_diffindiff <- function(data, model_fml, extra_fml, model_type = c("linear", "poisson"), do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = F, m_vals = c()) {
  model_type  <- match.arg(model_type)
  method_vals <- unique(data$conv_method)
  method_coefs <- list()

  for (cur_method in method_vals) {
    data_filtered <- data %>% filter(conv_method == cur_method)

    if (model_type == "poisson") {
      mod <- fepois(model_fml, data_filtered, offset = extra_fml)
    } else {
      mod <- feols(model_fml, data_filtered, weights = extra_fml, cluster = ~state)
    }

    method_coefs[[cur_method]] <- jackknife_supt(
      fe_fit    = mod,
      model_fml = model_fml,
      data      = data_filtered,
      model_type = model_type,
      extra_fml = extra_fml,
      do_se     = do_se,
      do_sensitivity = do_sensitivity,
      m_vals = m_vals
    ) %>%
      mutate(conv_method = cur_method)
  }

  return(bind_rows(method_coefs))
}

arrange_figure2 <- function(conv_method, conv_method_state, model_fml, wt_fml, model_type, title, do_se = TRUE, do_sensitivity = F, m_vals = c()) {
  interaction_colors <- c(
    "EUCA_nonconv"    = "#555555",
    "EUCA_conv"       = "#BBBBBB",
    "nonEUCA_nonconv" = "#004488",
    "nonEUCA_conv"    = "#6699CC"
  )
  
  clean_legend_labels <- c(
    "EUCA, Non-Convicted",
    "EUCA, Convicted",
    "Non-EUCA, Non-Convicted",
    "Non-EUCA, Convicted"
  )
  
  pal_method <- c(
    "CA_nonconv"  = "#004488", 
    "CA_conv"     = "#6699CC",
    "LEA_nonconv" = "#004488", 
    "LEA_conv"    = "#6699CC"
  )

  baseline <- if_else(model_type == "poisson", 1, 0)
  
  if (model_type == "poisson") {
    conv_method <- conv_method %>%
      group_by(conv_method, region) %>%
      mutate(ratio_baseline = ratio[window == -1],
             ratio = ratio / ratio_baseline) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  
  conv_method <- conv_method %>% 
    mutate(
      conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "_conv"), "conv", "nonconv"),
      color_group = paste0(region, "_", conv_status) 
    )
    
  make_left_plot <- function(df_filtered) {
    ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = window, y = ratio, 
                            group = interaction(conv_method, region), 
                            color = color_group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + 
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(conv_method$window), max(conv_method$window), by = 1)) +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = "Region & Status", 
        values = interaction_colors,
        breaks = names(interaction_colors),
        labels = clean_legend_labels
      ) +
      labs(x = "Window", y = "Arrests per 1k") +
      theme_classic() + 
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }
  
  plt.part_a <- make_left_plot(conv_method %>% filter(str_starts(conv_method, "CA")))
  plt.part_c <- make_left_plot(conv_method %>% filter(str_starts(conv_method, "LEA")))
  
  # y-axis limits for left side
  ylim_ac    <- range(c(plt.part_a$data$ratio, plt.part_c$data$ratio), na.rm = TRUE)
  plt.part_a <- plt.part_a + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_ac)
  plt.part_c <- plt.part_c + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_ac)

  model_list <- conv_method_state %>%
    group_split(conv_method) %>%
    map_dfr(function(.x) {
    current_method <- unique(.x$conv_method)

    message("Fitting model for conv_method: ", current_method)

    fit_diffindiff(.x, model_fml, wt_fml, model_type = model_type, do_se = do_se, do_sensitivity = do_sensitivity, m_vals = m_vals) %>% 
      mutate(conv_method = current_method)
    }) %>%
    mutate(conv_status = if_else(str_detect(conv_method, "_conv"), "conv", "nonconv"))

  possible_y_cols <- c("est", "lower", "upper", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")
  found_cols      <- intersect(possible_y_cols, colnames(model_list))
  ylim_bd         <- NULL
  
  tag_style_ac <- theme(
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    plot.tag.position = c(0.08, 0.98),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )
  
  tag_style_bd <- theme(
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    plot.tag.position = c(0.12, 0.98), 
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0)
  )
  
  if (length(found_cols) > 0) {
    raw_range <- range(model_list[, found_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
    padding   <- diff(raw_range) * 0.05
    ylim_bd   <- c(raw_range[1] - padding, raw_range[2] + padding)
  }

  plt.part_b <- event_study_plot(model_list %>% filter(str_starts(conv_method, "CA")), 
                                 pal = pal_method, baseline = baseline, show_guide = FALSE) + 
    labs(tag = "b")+ 
    tag_style_bd
  
  plt.part_d <- event_study_plot(model_list %>% filter(str_starts(conv_method, "LEA")), 
                                 pal = pal_method, baseline = baseline, show_guide = FALSE)+
    labs(tag = "d")+ 
    tag_style_bd
  
  if (!is.null(ylim_bd)) {
    plt.part_b <- plt.part_b + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bd)
    plt.part_d <- plt.part_d + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bd)
  }
    
  plt.part_a <- plt.part_a + ggtitle("Community Arrests") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) + 
    labs(tag = "a")+ 
    tag_style_ac
  
  plt.part_c <- plt.part_c + ggtitle("Law Enforcement Assisted Arrests") + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) + 
    labs(tag = "c")+ 
    tag_style_ac
  
  fig <- (plt.part_a + plt.part_b + plt.part_c + plt.part_d) +
    plot_layout(
      ncol = 2,
      guides = "collect",
      axis_titles = "collect"
    ) +
    plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "a",
      title = title,
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    )
  
  return(fig)
}

  paste0("n_arrests ~ i(window, region, ref = -1, ref2 = 'EUCA') | region + window")
)
offset_fml <- as.formula("~log_pop")

Test for significance
```{r, sig_test, echo = F}
trajectory <- read_csv("../data/glm_trajectory_type_threatlevel_convicted_ACS_MPI.csv")

# create four groups
trajectory <- trajectory %>%
  mutate(conv_method = ifelse(method == "LEA", 
                              ifelse(convicted == 1, "LEA_conv", "LEA_nonconv"),
                              ifelse(method == "CA", 
                                     ifelse(convicted == 1, "CA_conv", "CA_nonconv"),
                                     NA)))

conv_method_state <- aggregate_data(trajectory, c("conv_method", "region", "state", "window"), 
                                      "pop_MPI", 
                                      TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(conv_method)) %>%
  filter(window >= -1) %>%
  mutate(window = ifelse(window < 0, -1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(region, window, pop, state, conv_method) %>%
  summarize(n_arrests = sum(n_arrests)) %>%
  mutate(ratio = n_arrests/pop*1000)
  
return_p_value <- function(data){
  mod <- feols(model_fml, data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state)
  states <- unique(data$state)
  n_states <- length(states)
  jackknife_est_matrix <- t(sapply(states, function(dropped_state) {
    sub_data <- subset(data, state != dropped_state)
    coef(feols(model_fml, data = sub_data, weights = wt_fml, cluster = ~state))
  }))
  var = sum((jackknife_est_matrix - mean(jackknife_est_matrix))^2)*(n_states-1)/(n_states )
  se = sqrt(var)
  z = mean(jackknife_est_matrix)/se
  print(pnorm(-abs(z))*2)
  
  c(mean(jackknife_est_matrix),  mean(jackknife_est_matrix) - 1.96*se,  mean(jackknife_est_matrix) + 1.96*se)
}

print("LEA conv:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "LEA_conv"))

print("LEA nonconv:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "LEA_nonconv"))

print("CA conv:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "CA_conv"))

print("CA nonconv:")
return_p_value(conv_method_state %>% filter(conv_method == "CA_nonconv"))
```
